messages.tui.help:
DeepCode TUI

Usage:
  deepcode-tui [-C <workspace>] [--session <id>] [--plugin <plugin://uri>]...
  deepcode-tui [--language zh-CN|en-US] [--api <url>] [--no-auto-start-kernel] [--smoke]

--language overrides workbench.language; startup defaults to Simplified Chinese.
Use -C/--workspace to set the working directory for a new conversation.
--plugin is repeatable and selects plugins for the next request; type @ to open the same catalog.
Regular messages can be sent at any time and queue during a run; /reply 1 confirms a plan, /reply <text> revises a plan or answers a question; /reply 1/2 allows/denies an operation; /reply 3 allows host Shell for this run (when offered).
/cancel-plan cancels the plan; /cancel or Ctrl-C cancels the run; Esc clears input.
/focus <task> starts a task; /attach <path> attaches a directory; /detach <workspace-id> removes it; /model <profile> selects a model; /context shows context.
/help lists all interactive commands.
messages.tui.commandHelp:
DeepCode commands

/sessions List sessions (↑/↓, Enter to open, Esc to close)
/resume [number or full ID] Open a session; without an argument, show the list
/new Start a conversation in the startup directory without cancelling the previous run
@ Select plugins for the next request
/tasks View tasks
/context View context
/focus <task> Start a task
/model Choose connection and model; /model <profile> select a configured model directly
/attach <path> Attach a directory
/detach <workspace-id> Remove a directory index
/open <workspace-id> <logical-path> Read a file
/next Read the next section
/diff <record-id> <index> View changes
/reasoning Toggle reasoning details
/reasoning <request-id> [offset] Read reasoning on demand
/reasoning-history View reasoning history
/cancel Cancel the run
/cancel-plan Cancel the plan
/close Return to the conversation
/clear Clear input
/show View session information
/error Failure diagnostics and snapshot
/decision Current decision details
/tool <activity-id> Tool details
/quit Exit

PgUp / PgDn / mouse wheel scroll the current view; regular messages queue at any time; /reply <text> answers an interaction or revises a plan; /reply 1 confirms a plan; /reply 1/2 allows/denies an operation; /reply 3 allows host Shell for this run (when offered).
